name: Standup: post the digest in the afternoon

params.sql: SELECT name, yesterday, today, blockers FROM standup WHERE at > strftime('%s','now','start of day') ORDER BY name

params.template:
'*' + row.name + '*
• igår: ' + row.yesterday + '
• idag: ' + row.today + (row.blockers != '' ? '
• stopp: ' + row.blockers : '')
